items.text: You were told by a forklift driver who works at the warehouse, who is right about matters like this 3 times out of 4, that the warehouse's fire-safety certificate ran out last winter.

You checked the town fire service's certificate list yourself, which is right about matters like this 49 times out of 50. It shows that the Halden Road warehouse has a valid certificate until next June.
